what: A plate bound straight to scroll grows 1 → 1.8x. It stays sharp until 35% of the range, then dissolves as blur goes 0 → 8px and opacity 1 → 0. The range is 50% → 120% of the plate’s cover pass through the screen. Inside a pinned plate, the position at scroll 0 is taken as the document position to set the range (same as a CSS view() timeline), so the pinned hero image approaches and melts away over the first 1.4 screens of scroll. With size and blur set to 0 and only mid-opacity given, it becomes a stepped fade-out veil like 1 → .88 (35%) → 0.

options.from: Section start — how far the panel has passed through the screen (cover) %, default 50
options.mid: Ratio of the section held sharp (%), default 35 — up to here blur 0, transparent toward mid-opacity
options.scale: End scale, default 1.8 — 1 keeps the size
options.blur: End blur (px), default 8 — 0 means no blur
options.mid-opacity: Opacity at the mid position, default 1

from.where: index.html .ny-stage__art (person under a lamp — 1.8x · blur 8px · vanishing) · .ny-stage__pool (dark veil below — 1 → .88 → 0). The original is a Studio scroll animation (cover 50% → 120%, 35% keyframe)

note: Paints straight from the scroll value like a CSS scroll timeline (no smooth follow). The plate size is measured by the box without scale.
